doc.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

title: Darrel Calker of Walter Lantz becomes a writing mentor
summary: Through the cartoon world he met Walter Lantz musical director Darrel Calker, who mentored him and helped with his interest in writing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: You take it for granted, you know, because I was always exposed to it. Through that I actually met the musical director — he went from there to Walter Lantz, and he was very influential in bringing about Woody Woodpecker as well. And if you think about it © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

they’re pretty much the same characters, they’re both smart alecks. And so I had met the musical director of the cartoons at Walter Lantz, his name was Darrel Calker. And he became a mentor to me and gave me some education and help. I was interested in writing for a while and he was helping me with that. So that was all good. It was all good stuff.
